checked_sources.evidence: IAU defines 88 constellations as sky regions and supports use of Men.
Supports NGC 2031 in Mensa/LMC, LMC as Milky Way satellite, about 150,000 ly, Cepheids, and the stated contamination/blue-straggler hypotheses.
Supports near-infrared Cepheid photometry and construction of a period–luminosity relation for distance work.
Supports Norma as an IAU-defined sky region.
Supports Abell 3627/Norma-cluster location near the Norma–Triangulum Australe border, approximately 220 million ly, and foreground Milky Way obscuration.
Supports ram-pressure stripping of gas from ESO 137-001 within the Norma cluster.
Supports warm ionized gas traced to at least 87 kpc, three tails, and a regular stellar-rotation field against disturbed gas; it is an arXiv December 2022 submission.
Official journal record for DOI 10.1093/mnras/stad1003 gives publication date 2023-04-04, disproving a 2022 journal-publication claim.

articles.required_change: Replace 'Наблюдения MUSE, опубликованные в 2022 году' with 'Работа, выложенная на arXiv в 2022 году' or remove the year (journal publication was 2023, not 2022).

evidence: Read frozen JSON directly; canonical JSON SHA-256 recomputed with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':').
All six listed source URLs were independently opened. MEN factual claims match the IAU, NASA Hubble, and original Cepheid-study sources.

NOR physical claims match the IAU, NASA Hubble, NASA ESO 137-001, and arXiv:2212.03891 sources. The MUSE paper was submitted to arXiv in December 2022, while the MNRAS paper (DOI 10.1093/mnras/stad1003) was published 2023-04-04; therefore the current phrase 'опубликованные в 2022 году' is inaccurate.
